The structure of Dy8Ga16Si16 (Dy(GaSi)2) is tetragonal, space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 40 atoms per unit cell distributed over 6 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Dy centers with 10 neighbors (4 Ga, 6 Si), Ga centers with 9 neighbors (4 Ga, 1 Dy, 4 Si), and two distinct Si environments: 9 neighbors (4 Ga, 2 Dy, 3 Si) and 12 neighbors in a close-packed-like local arrangement. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Dy 10-vertex and Ga 9-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Ga 9-vertex and Si 9-vertex polyhedra.
